modules.name: WELLE
modules.description: Wavetable synth in the neon look: two oscillators with 32 built-in tables in folders and your own WAV wavetables, TABLE and POSITION, six warps, unison, GENRA's filters, MOTION in time, MUTATE, FREEZE. Follows GENRA and GENRA TECHNO.

modules.name: NEBEL
modules.description: Cluster universe: every note becomes a cloud of up to 8 voices (chords, spread, detune, chaos, drift, strum) from five generators, five textures and three huge reverbs; ORBIT turns it in time. Takes GENRA's chords.

modules.name: WOGE
modules.description: Scanned synthesis in the neon look: a string of masses on springs moves slowly, a scan head reads its shape at the pitch of the note. MASS, TENSION, DAMP, CENTER; HAMMER, PLUCK, NOISE, BOW or AUDIO excite it; PATH, WIDTH, DRIFT; filter, poly 4. Follows GENRA.

modules.name: PULS
modules.description: Pulsar synthesis in the neon look: a train of pulses with two formants. CLOCK (note values), FREE (0.25 Hz to 2 kHz: rhythm turns into tone) or NOTE (an instrument); a 16-step mask, DUTY, SKEW, JITTER, TAIL, a PULSE output. Follows GENRA.

modules.name: GLAS
modules.description: An ANS synthesizer in the neon look: paint on the glass with the mouse (pitch up, time across), a head plays it in time. PEN, SPRAY, LINE, ERASE, SNAP to the scale (also GENRA's key and chord), REC paints the spectrum of an input. Follows GENRA.

modules.name: FLUT
modules.description: A tidal drone in the neon look: up to six voices on GENRA's chord drift and glide; a slow tide (1 to 128 bars or up to 10 minutes) makes it louder, brighter and denser. Textures, sub, bloom, haze, TIDE and POLY outputs. Follows GENRA.
